sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by confocal immunofluorescence (L1) and SIM imaging (L2) in HUVECs; the tagged construct participates in SDC2/DEP1/VEGFR2 complex visualization. SDC2 intrinsic function (e.g., heparan sulfate-dependent signaling) not explicitly assayed for the tagged construct.
sites.rationale: SDC2 is a type-I single-pass transmembrane protein; its only extracellular terminus is the mature N-terminus beginning at residue 19 (after signal-peptide cleavage at residue 18). An N-terminal tag must therefore be placed after residue 18 (insert_after_residue=18, residue_before='A', residue_after='E'). No paper in the ledger names a specific residue number, so the junction is topology-derived from the landmark. The position is 130 residues from the TM boundary (149), well clear of the ≥3-residue constraint, and the 130-residue ectodomain provides ample steric room for a short epitope tag. Four independent ledger lines (L1/L2 SNAP-tag, L3/L4 HA-tag, L5 FLAG-tag) all report N-terminal tags on full-length membrane-anchored SDC2 with surface display confirmed. Human SDC2 carrying an N-terminal SNAP-tag (SDC2-SNAP) was expressed in HUVEC cells and visualized by confocal immunofluorescence and SIM imaging alongside DEP1-HA, confirming surface display of the full-length tagged protein. The same paper also reports N-terminal HA-tagged syndecans (including SDC2) accessible on the core protein without heparinase pre-treatment (L3). A separate paper (L4, PMC6450910) independently confirms HA-tagged SDC2 accessibility. L5 (PMC13345059) explicitly uses an N-FLAG-SDC2 construct transfected in HUVECs.

sources.claim: Scale bar: 25 μm. b , confocal image of HUVEC cells in basal conditions expressing both human DEP1 carrying N-terminal HA-tag (DEP1-HA, red) and human Sdc2 carrying N-terminal SNAP-tag (SDC2-SNAP, green) proteins.

literature_notes: All six ledger lines converge on the same N-terminal extracellular junction (after SP cleavage, residue 18→19): L1/L2 (SNAP-tag, surface display confirmed by confocal and SIM), L3/L4 (HA-tagged SDC2 accessible on core protein, two independent papers), L5 (N-FLAG-SDC2 in HUVECs). No ledger line names a specific residue number, so position_evidence is topology_derived for all. L6 (V5-tagged mouse Sdc2 via adenovirus) does not state whether the tag is N- or C-terminal; the C-terminus of SDC2 is intracellular (residues 170–201), so a C-terminal V5 would not be a surface site. Because the quote is silent on position, L6 cannot be placed in either sites or other_positions with confidence and is noted here only. No internal ectodomain insertions are reported in the ledger for SDC2. No function-abrogating or cytoplasmic insertions are reported in the ledger.
